title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering to prevent regional thrashing
author: Maya Chen
description:
Background: In the last incident (SUP-3421 / ENG-2187) we observed regional thrashing where the SLO enforcer's backoff decisions would oscillate between regions under bursty cross-region traffic. Root cause analysis showed a race in our backoff ordering logic plus overly-aggressive minimum backoff/smoothing settings that allowed short-lived spikes to flip region priorities.

This PR contains a targeted hotfix that: 1) fixes the ordering/race in the BackoffManager so decisions are deterministic and monotonic per region, 2) increases conservative defaults (min_backoff, smoothing_window) to reduce sensitivity to short spikes, 3) adds telemetry and integration tests that reproduce the thrashing pattern so regressions are detectable.

Checklist: 
- [x] Fix ordering race in BackoffManager
- [x] Add unit and integration tests for ordering/backoff smoothing
- [x] Adjust conservative helm/values defaults for production
- [x] Add telemetry metrics for backoff decisions and region priority changes
- [x] Run smoke tests and canary in staging before merge

Motivation: This is a production-impacting stability hotfix triggered by customer-facing latency regressions during cross-region failover. The changes are intentionally conservative: we bias toward stability over aggressive failover to avoid oscillation. Related: ENG-2190 (follow-up to allow adaptive tuning), SUP-3421 incident notes.

Notes on risk and rollout: Changes are small and localized to the SLO enforcer; default values are conservative. We will rollout to dedicated staging canaries for 2 hours and monitor new telemetry: backoff_decision_count, region_priority_changed, backoff_smoothing_applied. If stable, we will promote to production via the standard canary window and a single-region -> multi-region ramp.
commits: Fix deterministic ordering in BackoffManager to eliminate race between evaluation loops
Add unit tests for backoff ordering and monotonicity
Increase default min_backoff from 250ms -> 1s and smoothing_window from 3 -> 8
Update helm values and docs; add repro script for integration test
